newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan opposition province deputy said abducted.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan opposition province deputy said abducted.

text.p: A provincial opposition deputy in Pakistan's southern province of Sindh, Pir Mazharul Haq, was kidnapped by armed men on Thursday, his wife said.

She said Haq, a former provincial minister and a member of the Pakistan People's Party of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto, was kidnapped by four armed men on a highway when he was driving to Hyderabad to offer condolences on a relative's death.
There was no immediate information about the kidnapping.
Police later took Haq's wife to the site of the kidnapping for investigation, police sources said.
